# Russo NV

> Industrial painting and coating contractor in Antwerp, Belgium, founded 1994. Industrial painting, abrasive blasting, tank coating and tank lining, corrosion protection to ISO 12944, and fireproofing for petrochemical, marine and manufacturing clients across Belgium and the Benelux. VCA and ISO 9001 certified. On-site work on tank terminals, refineries and industrial plants.

Russo NV (Taxandriastraat 33-35, 2170 Antwerpen, Belgium, +32 475 43 48 19) performs
industrial coating projects on location: storage tanks (interior linings and exterior
systems), steel structures, pipe racks and silos. Recent reference projects include
16 new-build storage tanks at Ghent Tank Storage in the Port of Ghent and the silo
renovation for Albeton in Diemen (NL). Dutch-speaking (primary) and English-speaking.

## Services

- [Industriele schilderwerken (industrial painting)](https://www.russonv.com/services/industriele-schilderwerken): core service, industrial paint systems applied on site
- [Tankcoating & tank lining](https://www.russonv.com/services/tankcoating): tank exteriors and chemical-resistant internal linings
- [Industrieel stralen (abrasive blasting)](https://www.russonv.com/services/industrieel-stralen): grit blasting to Sa 2.5/Sa 3, vacuum blasting, confined spaces
- [Corrosiebescherming (corrosion protection)](https://www.russonv.com/services/corrosiebescherming): complete coating systems to ISO 12944, C2 to C5
